Sitemap lists 14 URLs while 5,221 URLs are not indexed (1,963 discovered, 931 crawled, not indexed)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt is well structured and allows ChatGPT-User on purpose
All 399 crawled pages returned 200 (no 5xx); lang="es" declared
Search Console shows indexed pages growing from 390 to 5,774 (10 Jul to 19 Sep 2026)

findings.title: No canonical tag on any crawled page
findings.description: 0 of 399 crawled pages (300 hotels, 62 collections, 17 regions, 7 cities, 6 chains, others) have rel=canonical. Search Console reports 492 pages as 'Duplicate without user-selected canonical'.
findings.recommendation: Output a self-referencing absolute canonical on every indexable template (one host, lowercase slug).

findings.title: Almost every hotel is linked under two URL variants, both returning 200
findings.description: 3,080 of 3,235 hotel IDs seen in internal links appear with two slugs (hyphen and underscore, e.g. /hotels/4839/blackberry-farm.html and /hotels/4839/blackberry_farm.html). Any slug resolves with 200 (/hotels/1048/anything.html). Search Console shows 81 IDs indexed under 2-3 variants.
findings.recommendation: Pick one slug per ID, 301 all variants, return 404 for unknown IDs, canonicalize.

findings.title: Head markup is malformed on all hotel, collection, city and chain pages
findings.description: 289 of 300 hotel pages, 61 of 62 collections, 7 of 7 cities and 6 of 6 chains contain <meta name="title" content=" with no closing quote, which swallows the next tag; the meta description is lost (a parser finds a description on only 32 of 399 pages). The same pages contain a hreflang tag cut off at href="https://www.solo5estrellas.com/hotels/ >, which swallows the following script block.
findings.recommendation: Fix the template: close the quotes, fill the title variable or remove the tag, repair hreflang. Re-crawl and check Search Console URL Inspection.

findings.title: Soft 404s and malformed hotel URLs
findings.description:
Unknown IDs return 200 (/cities/9999/foo.html). 14 hotel links contain
, ** or tabs inside the slug (e.g. /hotels/2894/sonora_resort__
_all-inclusive.html) and return 400. Search Console: 120 pages not found (404), 65 redirect pages.
findings.recommendation: Sanitize slugs at the source; real 404/410 for missing IDs; fix internal links.

findings.title: Legacy parameter URLs are indexed and carry traffic
findings.description: 11 browse_*.cfm?id URLs appear in Search Console; browse_country.cfm?countryid=64 (Islas Turcas y Caicos) has 29 of 124 clicks and returns 200 with title 'Bienvenido', no canonical, no redirect.
findings.recommendation: 301 each legacy URL to its clean URL, then rebuild the page.

findings.title: Sitemap covers 14 URLs; robots.txt has no Sitemap line
findings.description: /sitemap.xml lists 14 URLs (no hotels, cities, chains, regions; identical lastmod). The crawl found about 3,235 hotel IDs from hub links alone. Search Console shows 5,221 not-indexed URLs including 1,963 'Discovered - currently not indexed' and 931 'Crawled - currently not indexed'.
findings.recommendation: Segmented sitemap index with real lastmod; add Sitemap: to robots.txt; submit in GSC and Bing.

findings.title: Server response is slow on city pages
findings.description: City pages average 2.5 s to first byte (New York 3.4 s, London 3.0 s, Cancun 2.8 s); other templates 0.4-0.6 s.
findings.recommendation: Cache city pages; lazy-load hotel lists.

findings.title: No cache headers or security headers; software disclosed
findings.description: Home response has no Cache-Control, ETag, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options or similar; X-Powered-By: ASP.NET and Server: Microsoft-IIS/10.0 are exposed; CFID cookie expires in 2056.
findings.recommendation: Add caching, HSTS and standard headers; remove version headers; session cookies.

findings.title: 1,646 pages blocked by robots.txt in Search Console
findings.description: The crawl found 500 internal links to /booking/ (intended Disallow). Example URLs for the 1,646 are not in the export, so it is unconfirmed that only /booking/ is affected.
findings.recommendation: Open Page indexing > Blocked by robots.txt and confirm example URLs.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Hotel pages: median 1,233 words with expert perspective, benefits comparison and FAQ
Collection pages average 2,237 words; chain pages 3,195 words; region pages 3,886 words
Spanish copy is generally readable and professional

findings.title: 31% of sampled hotel pages are thin
findings.description: 94 of 300 hotel pages have under 300 words of visible text (about 210 words, e.g. Amanjiwo, Amankora, Conrad Dublin, W Sydney).
findings.recommendation: Expert text and verified benefits before indexing; noindex until improved.

findings.title: Repetitive template text and AI-generated sections
findings.description: The repo's content scorer flags the sampled hotel page 'repetitive' (36 repetition score; overall 95). Pros and cons, ratings and comparisons are labeled as AI-generated.
findings.recommendation: Human review, unique first paragraphs and FAQ answers per hotel.

findings.title: Spanish copy defects (see proposal section 4)
findings.description: Mixed tu/usted, Title Case, typos such as 'Excusive' in 67 of 68 chain/collection titles and 'Nnoche' in offers, English titles on core pages.
findings.recommendation: Spanish editorial style guide and template fixes.

findings.title: No editorial content
findings.description: No guides, comparisons, neighborhood pages or named authors; Search Console shows head terms nearly absent (hoteles de lujo: 5 impressions).
findings.recommendation: City hubs and content clusters per the proposal.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Each page type has one H1 (398 of 399; /hotels-by-flight-time/ has none)
Hotel titles are unique per hotel

findings.title: Meta descriptions missing or generic
findings.description: 367 of 399 pages have no readable meta description (head bug above); 24 carry the sitewide generic 'Los mejores hoteles de lujo de 5 estrellas del mundo'; all 17 region pages use it.
findings.recommendation: Unique descriptions from template fields.

findings.title: Titles: wrong language, typo, generic, too long
findings.description: 7 pages titled 'Bienvenido'; English titles on /collection/, /destinations/, /destination/; 'Preferred Partner | Official Excusive Perks' on 67 of 68 chain and collection pages (English, typo, duplicate pattern); median title length 66 characters, 275 of 399 over 60 because of the suffix '| Solo 5 Estrellas por Lorraine Travel'. 19 titles are shared by 44 pages.
findings.recommendation: Spanish title templates under 60 characters, brand shortened.

findings.title: hreflang wrong everywhere
findings.description: No crawled page has a self-referencing es tag; hotel, collection, city and chain pages have a malformed es tag and no x-default; region and hub pages point es to the homepage and x-default to the English homepage.
findings.recommendation: Page-level reciprocal es/en pairs with WhataHotel.

findings.title: Hotel pages have no links to their own city, country, chain or guide
findings.description: Hotel pages average 43 internal links, almost all global navigation; no breadcrumbs on hotel pages (BreadcrumbList on 0 of 300).
findings.recommendation: Template-level contextual links and breadcrumbs.

findings.title: Loading messages are H2 headings
findings.description: 'Cargando tarifas...' and similar are <h2> on hotel pages.
findings.recommendation: Use non-heading elements.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: JSON-LD present on all 399 pages; FAQPage on 190 of 300 hotels; rich chain/collection graphs (BreadcrumbList, FAQPage, ItemList) on 67 pages

findings.title: JSON-LD text is corrupted with replacement characters on 206 pages
findings.description: The schema text contains U+FFFD in place of accented letters (e.g. 'n?mero', 'Cr?dito'). It is not visible in page text, but search engines and AI systems read it.
findings.recommendation: Fix the encoding at the data source; re-validate.

findings.title: No Hotel or LodgingBusiness schema; offers modeled as zero-price
findings.description: 0 of 300 hotel pages have Hotel schema; 206 carry TravelAgency + Offer with price 0 and OnlineOnly availability.
findings.recommendation: Add Hotel entity; describe perks as visible text.

findings.title: Organization graph points to WhataHotel profiles and omits Lorraine Travel
findings.description: sameAs lists facebook.com/whatahotel and instagram.com/whatahotel; no parentOrganization.
findings.recommendation: Rebuild entity graph.

findings.title: City, region, and home pages carry only Organization and WebSite
findings.description: 7 cities and 17 regions have no BreadcrumbList or ItemList.
findings.recommendation: Add on hubs where the visible list matches.

findings.title: Chain and collection schema may over-claim
findings.description: Chain/collection graphs include TravelAgency with OpeningHoursSpecification and GeoCoordinates on brand pages; verify these match visible content.
findings.recommendation: Remove properties not shown on the page.

findings.title: Core Web Vitals not measured
findings.description: PageSpeed Insights API quota was exhausted (HTTP 429) and the audit tool's own fetchers were blocked by this sandbox's proxy guard. Server timing and page weight were measured instead: HTML 14-180 KB; city pages 2.5 s TTFB.
findings.recommendation: Pull CrUX and Lighthouse from Search Console or a local run.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: robots.txt allows OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and ChatGPT-User except /booking/
Search Console shows 1,343 impressions in Google AI features since 18 May 2026 (Spain 304, Mexico 238, Argentina 170)

findings.title: Claims lack sources, dates and named authors
findings.description: Perks (breakfast for two, $100 credit) are stated without verification dates or program terms; no named experts.
findings.recommendation: Verified-benefits blocks and advisor profiles.

findings.title: No llms.txt, no markdown alternates
findings.description: /llms.txt returns 404. Google does not use it; the benefit is optional.
findings.recommendation: Low priority.

findings.title: Brand entity unclear
findings.description: Brand queries earned 3 clicks and 137 impressions; the schema graph does not link Solo5Estrellas to Lorraine Travel.
findings.recommendation: Entity strategy in proposal section 18.

findings.title: No hotel images in server HTML
findings.description: All 300 sampled hotel pages contain exactly 1 (the logo); 323 of 399 pages have one or none. Galleries are probably JavaScript-loaded. Image alt text and lazy loading could not be assessed.
findings.recommendation: Server-render the hero image with alt text, dimensions and fetchpriority; lazy-load the rest. Confirm with GSC URL Inspection.
